proves.claim: With submit.regenerateDeclared on, a declared generator that exits non-zero refuses submit GENERATED_STALE with the generator output in the message.

cli.journeys-submit-regenerate-declared..why: Without it, a regression where a failing declared generator stopped refusing submit with its output would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: With submit.regenerateDeclared on, a project declaring no generated file submits unchanged.

cli.journeys-submit-regenerate-declared..why: Without it, a regression where a project declaring no generated file stopped submitting unchanged would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: With submit.regenerateDeclared on, a submit whose diff changes a declared input commits the regenerated file.

cli.journeys-submit-regenerate-declared..why: Without it, a regression where with submit.regenerateDeclared on, a submit whose diff changes a declared input commits the regenerated file would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: With submit.regenerateDeclared at its default (off), the same submit leaves the generated file as committed.

cli.journeys-submit-regenerate-declared..why: Without it, a regression where with submit.regenerateDeclared at its default (off), the same submit leaves the generated file as committed would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: A composed slice commit changing a path outside the slice set is refused SLICE_PATHS with slices.enforcePaths on.

cli.journeys-submit-slice-paths-composed.why: Without it, a regression where a composed slice commit changing a path outside the slice set is refused SLICE_PATHS with slices.enforcePaths on would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: The same composed commit goes through with the setting at its default (off).

cli.journeys-submit-slice-paths-composed.why: Without it, a regression where the same composed commit goes through with the setting at its default (off) would pass unnoticed.
